examples.text: The loss the National Library suffered from the fire is incalculable.

examples.text: He is incalculable when he's drunk. He can turn from an amiable person into a violent horror in a moment.

examples.text: "His contribution has been immeasurable," Bush said in a statement. "I value his judgment, and I treasure his friendship."

examples.text: The side and diagonal of a square are incommensurable with each other; the diameter and circumference of a circle are incommensurable.

examples.text: Unfortunately for Pythagoras, his theorem led at once to the discovery of incommensurables, which appeared to disprove his whole philosophy.

examples.text: Entre elles deux se trouve l'incommensurable différence du prévu à l'imprévu, de la force à la faiblesse.
